content:
incident-bot: PAGER: high tail latency observed in eu-west serving pool affecting economy tier (alerts: p95 > 1.2s, error rate +0.8% over baseline). tagging ops and oncall. https://monitoring.internal/alerts/328901

maria: ack — i'm oncall. jumping in to triage.

kevin: pinging infra - any recent deploys to eu-west?

ops-rotations: deploys: none in last 45m. autoscaler fired a few times for economy pool at 11:08Z.

maria: looks like economy nodes spiked queue depth. early hypothesis: batch sizing + slow KV cache misses for long prompts.

sanjay: customer impact: 12 orgs with SLO protections, 3 paying customers reported slow UI (chat latency). severity: P2.

lia: suggest immediate traffic shaping: divert new economy requests in eu-west to latency-priority route (short-circuit economy routing), and apply temporary soft-disable on economy tier for public traffic while preserving dedicated/reserved customers.

ash: approved. what's the shortest safe change to reduce tail?

maria: two-prong: 1) increase per-request rate-limit for economy to reduce burst packing (throttle to smooth) 2) set smart-routing policy: region eu-west: prefer latency-tier models for production until KPIs stable.

ben: i can push policy change. executing admin API now:

ben: ```
# soft-disable economy for public routing in eu-west for 10m
curl -X POST https://console.api.internal/v1/routing/policies/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","match":{"tier":"economy","customer_type":"public"},"action":{"set_preference":"latency","enabled":true,"override_tier":"standard"},"ttl":"10m","reason":"emergency: tail latency spike"}'
```

maria: executing now. watching dashboards.

incident-bot: policy update job queued (job_id: job-7862).

ben: job applied at 3323456815, patch id=policy-evict-3323.

lia: also bumping rate-limit for economy by 20% to smooth bursts:

lia: ```
curl -X POST https://console.api.internal/v1/quotas/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","tier":"economy","delta":"-20%","reason":"smooth bursts during incident"}'
```

maria: metrics: p95 dropped from 1.25s -> 540ms over 90s, queue depth normalizing. error rate back to +0.1% above baseline.

sanjay: contacting impacted customers (legal/prod) to notify about mitigation and potential small rate reductions.

kevin: any rollback plan if this increases cost or affects standard tier?

lia: automated rollback: policy TTL 10m. will auto-revert. if costs spike, we can revert immediately with job-rollback command.

ash: keep detailed notes in incident doc: https://incidents.internal/3323456789

ops-rotations: oncall handoff in 40m to kevin. maria to do warm handoff with notes.

maria: warm handoff: summary -> economy eu-west tail latency due to cache miss + burst; mitigation -> smart-routing enforced latency preference for public economy traffic, rate-limit smoothing; status -> stable, continue monitoring for next 20m, customer outreach in progress.

eng-oncall: log snippet from routing service around 11:07Z:

eng-oncall: ```
[11:07:15] WARN routing: backend response slow (kv-miss 210ms) model=gpt-ec-1 region=eu-west-1
[11:07:17] INFO batching: queued 120 reqs, avg batch=14, tail=340ms
[11:07:30] ERROR serve: downstream timeout 502 count=3
```

maria: follow-ups: 1) add a transient cache heat-up in eu-west for hot prefixes 2) add a guardrail to avoid large batch growth when kv-miss rate > 5%. filing tickets.

sanjay: filing post-incident outreach to impacted customers; PM will own messaging.

ben: policy auto-revert executed at 3323456875 (ttl expired). metrics holding: p95=560ms, errors within baseline.

maria: closing loop: continued monitoring for 30m then incident->resolved. great quick response, team. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident update: status=monitoring -> resolved if no regression in 30m. recorded runbook steps under incident-3323456789.

kevin: thanks all — will pick this up during handoff.
